item: 1. NLD De Drentse Monden En Oostermoer: capacity, turbine, year
farm: De Drentse Monden En Oostermoer wind farm
proposal: fix('NLD', 'De Drentse Monden En Oostermoer wind farm', G, '風場共 45 部 Nordex N131/3900（測試機 2019 年夏天先在現場裝設，其餘 44 部 2019 年 12 月下單），總裝置容量 175.5 MW（經濟部 2022 年政府公報）；荷蘭企業局（RVO）《2021 陸域風電監測》：2021 年全場建成，2022 年 1 月 45 部全部運轉。原寫 156.8 MW、年份不詳', 'The farm has 45 Nordex N131/3900 turbines (a test unit put up on site in summer 2019, the other 44 ordered in Dec 2019), 175.5 MW in all (Ministry of Economic Affairs notice, Staatscourant 2022); RVO’s Monitor Wind op Land 2021: the whole farm was built in 2021 and all 45 turbines were running in January 2022. The row said 156.8 MW with no year', 'https://www.rvo.nl/sites/default/files/2022-05/Monitor-wind-op-land-2021_0.pdf', mw=175.5, year=2021, turbine='45x Nordex N131/3900'),
note_zh: 45 部 Nordex N131/3900、175.5 MW；RVO 2021 監測報告：2021 年全場建成、2022 年 1 月 45 部全部運轉，所以年份寫 2021（若要以「全部運轉」為準可改 2022）。RVO 同報告的德倫特省表格只算 171.6 MW（44 部），差的 1 部可能在省界外（公報列出的鄉鎮含格羅寧根省的 Stadskanaal），未另查證。
note_en: 45 Nordex N131/3900, 175.5 MW; RVO’s 2021 monitor: the whole farm was built in 2021 and all 45 turbines were running in January 2022, hence year 2021 (2022 if “all running” is preferred). The same report’s Drenthe table counts only 171.6 MW (44 units); the missing unit may lie outside the province (the notice lists Stadskanaal, Groningen, among the municipalities) — not checked further.
why: Primary sources: RVO Monitor Wind op Land 2021 (government agency), the Staatscourant notice of 23 June 2022, the Raad van State ruling of 30 April 2025 (45 turbines), Nordex’s order release (reposted by renewable-energy-industry.com; nordex-online.com URL 404). GEM’s 156.8 MW = 46.8 + 47 + 63 sub-parks does not match 45 × 3.9.

item: 2. IND Atria Basavana Bagewadi I (119 MW) + II (40 MW): double count, year, location
farm: Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) I wind farm / Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) II wind farm
proposal:
dup('IND', 'Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) II wind farm', G, ('Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) I wind farm', G), '同一座風場：Vestas 稱 Basavane Bagewadi 風場全場 120 MW、分三期各 40 MW（各 18 部 V110）；「Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) I」（119 MW）已是全場，這筆 40 MW 是其中一期，重複計算', 'Same farm: Vestas describes the Basavane Bagewadi farm as 120 MW in three 40 MW phases (18 V110 units each); “Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) I” (119 MW) already stands for the whole farm, so this 40 MW record is one of its phases counted twice', 'https://www.vestas.com/en/media/company-news/2017/vestas-receives-40-mw-order-in-india-c2963504'),
fix('IND', 'Basavana Bagewadi (Atria) I wind farm', G, 'Atria 在比賈布爾縣 Basavana Bagewadi 的 120 MW 風場，三期共 54 部 Vestas V110（2.2 MW）；其中兩家專案公司（Atria Wind Power (Bijapur 1) 與 (Basavana Bagewadi)，各 39.6 MW）2018 年 4 月 18 日商轉（CARE 信評報告），第三期的商轉日期未查到。原座標（北緯 12.975°、東經 77.726°）是班加羅爾的代用點，改用 Basavana Bagewadi 鎮的位置（概略位置）', 'Atria’s 120 MW farm at Basavana Bagewadi, Bijapur district: three phases, 54 Vestas V110 units (2.2 MW); two of its project companies (Atria Wind Power (Bijapur 1) and (Basavana Bagewadi), 39.6 MW each) reached commercial operation on 18 Apr 2018 (CARE rating reports); the third phase’s date was not found. The old point (12.975 N, 77.726 E) was a Bengaluru placeholder; it now uses the town of Basavana Bagewadi (approximate)', 'https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/21102021044859_Atria_Wind_Power_(Bijapur_1)_Private_Limited.pdf', year=2018, lat=16.583, lon=75.967, approx=True, turbine='54x Vestas V110 (2.2 MW)'),
note_zh: 全場 120 MW 三期各 18 部 V110（第三期是 V110-2.0 以 2.2 MW 模式運轉），54 × 2.2 = 118.8 MW，與 GEM 的 119 MW 相符，所以容量不改；II（40 MW）是其中一期、刪除。兩家 39.6 MW 專案公司 2018-04-18 商轉；第三期（可能是 Atria Wind Power (Chitradurga)，也是 39.6 MW）未查到商轉日與位置。
note_en: The farm is 120 MW in three phases of 18 V110 each (phase 3 V110-2.0 run in 2.2 MW mode); 54 × 2.2 = 118.8 MW, matching GEM’s 119 MW, so the capacity stays; II (40 MW) is one phase and goes. Two 39.6 MW project companies started commercial operation on 18 Apr 2018; the third phase (possibly the 39.6 MW Atria Wind Power (Chitradurga) company) has no date or location found.
why: Vestas’ three order releases (2017) and two CARE Ratings rationales (2021, 2023) for Atria SPVs at Basavana Bagewadi. Town coordinates from en.wikipedia (Basavana Bagewadi). Not resolved: the third phase’s COD (Vestas expected Q2 2018); the Himatsingka BSE filing lists a 39.6 MW “Atria Wind Power (Chitradurga)” SPV whose site is unstated — the GEM record “Chitradurga (Atria) wind farm” (23 MW) sits at Vijayapura city (16.831, 75.704), also a placeholder, not checked here.

item: 3d. IND TEECL Wind Project 2 (Tamil Nadu placeholder)
note_zh: Techno Electric（子公司 Simran Wind Project）在坦米爾納德邦的風場分在不同縣：IFC 2011 年揭露的 126.9 MW 擴建在 Muthianpatti（蒂魯布爾縣 Dharapuram 區）、Amdhapuram 與 Rasta，在地文件放在蒂魯布爾縣與蒂魯內爾維利縣的村公所；2015 年又出售 44.45 MW。沒有單一地點可用，現有座標（10.68 N、78.40 E，蒂魯奇拉帕利附近）不在這些地方。
note_en: Techno Electric’s Tamil Nadu wind (through Simran Wind Project) is spread over several districts: the 126.9 MW expansion disclosed by IFC in 2011 is at Muthianpatti (Dharapuram taluk, Tiruppur), Amdhapuram and Rasta, with local documents at village offices in Tiruppur and Tirunelveli districts; 44.45 MW was sold in 2015. There is no single locality, and the current point (10.68 N, 78.40 E, near Tiruchirappalli) is at none of them.
why: A multi-site record; a single approximate point would mislead. Which units remain in the 111 MW record after the 2015 sale is unknown (Techno annual reports not reached).

The Qiman 1,000 MW wind-storage project TBEA announced in June 2024 has no record of construction', 'https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1820129249520114866&wfr=spider&for=pc', rename='Xinjiang Ruoqiang River (TBEA) wind farm', zhname='特变电工若羌县若羌河100万千瓦风电及配套储能项目', note=True),
note_zh: GEM 把兩個項目混在一起：記錄名是「祁曼」，但別名、一期 750 MW「營運中」的出處都是若羌河 100 萬瓩項目（羅布莊風區，2024-12-31 首台併網）。祁曼 1,000 MW（一期 200、二期 800 MW，2024-06 公告）查無開工或併網報導。若羌河項目何時全容量併網、750 MW 是否已運轉都查不到；座標（38.374 N、89.96 E）在祁曼一帶而非羅布莊風區，羅布莊風區沒有可引用的座標。
note_en: GEM mixes two projects: the record is named “Qiman”, but its other name and the source for phase 1 (750 MW operating) are the Ruoqiang River 1 GW project (Luobuzhuang wind area, first turbine on the grid on 31 Dec 2024). The Qiman 1,000 MW project (200 + 800 MW, announced June 2024) has no construction or connection report. When Ruoqiang River reached full connection, and whether 750 MW runs, is not found; the point (38.374 N, 89.96 E) is in the Qiman area, not Luobuzhuang, and no citable Luobuzhuang coordinates were found.
why: Tried: TBEA’s Q1 2025 generation notice (cninfo, provincial totals only), the NEA page GEM cites (no mention), the Xinjiang 750 kV EIA PDF (404), searches for 全容量并网. A rename would also need the “· 2” phase record (250 MW construction, owner TBEA Xinjiang Sunoasis, refs from 2023–24 that fit the Ruoqiang River start in Oct 2023).

item: 6. CHN Envision Ejin Horo: Ordos Zero Carbon Park (440 MW) vs Yijinhuoluo Smart Energy (200 MW)

note_zh: 兩筆都是遠景在伊金霍洛旗的項目：智慧綜合能源 200 MW 風電示範項目列在內蒙古 2021 年保障性併網名單（遠景、20 萬瓩、儲能 30%/2h）；零碳產業園 500 MW 風光儲項目含風電 440 MW。查不到 200 MW 項目是否就是 440 MW 的一部分，也查不到各自的併網日期，不能判定重複。
note_en: Both are Envision projects in Ejin Horo Banner: the Smart Energy 200 MW wind demonstration project is on Inner Mongolia’s 2021 guaranteed-grid list (Envision, 200 MW, storage 30%/2h); the Zero-Carbon Park 500 MW wind-solar-storage project includes 440 MW of wind. Whether the 200 MW became part of the 440 MW, and either project’s connection date, are not found, so no duplicate can be shown.
why: kjt.nmg.gov.cn / ordos.gov.cn blocked in round 18; no approval document for the zero-carbon park’s wind found. Points differ (39.70 N 109.54 E vs 39.24 N 109.83 E, ~55 km apart).

note_en: SPIC Xinjiang’s Altay 250 MW guaranteed-grid wind project “is located in the Irtysh valley wind area of Qialeshihai township, Jeminay county”; township coordinates from Chinese Wikipedia.

note_zh: 426 MW＝Delta 3（96 部）＋Delta 5、6＋Delta 7、8（共 172 部）。查到的機型都是 GE：Delta 6 是 GE 風機（2019 年倒塌事件，GE 聲明），Delta 7 III 是 13 部 GE 2.7-116（GlobalData），Delta 3 在 The Wind Power 記為 GE 2.3-116（96 × 2.3 = 220.8 MW，但該頁的業主與位置不一致）。沒有任何出處提到 Vestas 或 Nordex，但 Delta 3、5、8 沒有可靠的機型出處，無法替全場寫一個機型。
note_en: 426 MW = Delta 3 (96 units) + Delta 5 and 6 + Delta 7 and 8 (172 units in all). Every model found is GE: Delta 6 is GE (2019 collapse, GE statement), Delta 7 III is 13 × GE 2.7-116 (GlobalData), and The Wind Power lists Delta 3 as GE 2.3-116 (96 × 2.3 = 220.8 MW, though that page’s owner and location are inconsistent). No source mentions Vestas or Nordex, but Delta 3, 5 and 8 have no reliable model source, so no field for the whole complex can be written.
why: ANEEL’s open data (SIGA, generating units) has no turbine model; Omega/Serena investor pages not reached; GE press releases found cover other Brazilian farms. Suggest removing “Vestas/Nordex” or writing “GE” once Delta 3’s model is confirmed from a primary source.

item: 10. MEX Amistad (200 MW, no year) and Amistad II–IV
note_zh: Amistad 一期 200 MW 2017 年 3 月開工（Enel）、原定 2018 年 10 月交付，仍查不到實際商轉日期。Amistad II、III、IV（合計 350 MW）2022 年 7 月報導「已可運轉，但因能源管制委員會（CRE）不發發電許可停擺兩年」；本站資料目前只有 Amistad 一筆（GEM 的 II–IV 標為暫停，未進風場層），不需修改。
note_en: Amistad phase 1 (200 MW) started construction in March 2017 (Enel) with delivery planned for Oct 2018; the actual commercial-operation date is still not found. Amistad II, III and IV (350 MW together) were reported in July 2022 as “ready to operate but stopped for two years for lack of CRE generation permits”; the layer has only the one Amistad record (GEM’s II–IV are mothballed and not in the layer), so nothing to change there.
why: proyectosmexico.gob.mx fails TLS verification here (incomplete certificate chain), so its project sheets (Amistad II start 30 Jun 2019, III 26 Feb 2025, IV 31 Dec 2028 per search results) cannot be quoted; Enel annual reports not reached. The 188.1 MW (57 × G132) vs 200 MW question also remains (The Wind Power only).
